ui.P力量：带头进攻、自卫和合资格支援。GP全球力量：不满足P支援条件时使用；P与G:
P (Power): Leads attacks, self-defends, and provides eligible support. GP (Global Power): Support when P is not eligible. Never add P and GP. R (Resistance): Base defense against Control.

Opposites: Government–Corporate, Liberal–Conservative, Peaceful–Violent, Straight–Weird, Fanatic–Fanatic. Criminal has no opposite. Fanatic never counts as a shared alignment.
Control: Compare leader with target. +4 per shared alignment; −4 per opposing pair. Destroy reverses these modifiers.

Loyalty: +4 per alignment shared with the direct parent; Control defense only. Opposing alignments do not subtract loyalty.
Position: +10 for direct subordinates of the Illuminati, +5 for the next level, +0 deeper. Applies to Control and Destroy.
Self-defense: Spend the target’s action for an extra 2 × P defense.

Support: Compare supporter with the attacked target. Control attack: shared alignment uses P. Destroy attack: opposing alignments use P. Defense: shared alignment or direct parent/child uses P. Otherwise use GP. Normally costs the supporter’s action.

Tags are separate: Military, Communist, Magic, Space, Celebrity, Place, etc. matter only when named by a rule or card. They give no automatic alignment modifier. Huge and Coastal are also tags.

Small cards abbreviate alignments; inspect a card to see the full names.

Action ability: Once during your main phase, spend this group's action unless stated otherwise.
Restore: The card must have no action, no extra refresh used, and must not have entered play or been seized this turn.

While in play: Persists through ownership changes; clears on leaving play.
Direct aura: Applies only to the specified direct parent or subordinate. Ends if the source is disabled or the relationship ends.
Lost slots: The controller returns excess branches to hand. Voluntary moves must leave legal capacity.

Attachments move with their group and are discarded when it leaves play.
A branch includes the group and all descendants; moving it does not reset its state.
Preparedness: At most 1; consumed for +4 disaster defense.
Temporary alignments expire at turn end. Discard excess hand cards when required.

Goal Plots count toward your Plot hand limit; keep at most 1. Play one during your main phase when its goal is met to declare victory. It may be countered and costs no action.

Extra draw: Spend your Illuminati's action to draw 1 card from any deck. Resource hand limit: 2; cannot draw Resources at capacity.
Deployment and Automatic Takeover each have a separate once-per-turn use; each normally costs your Illuminati's action.
At most 2 resources in play, beside the Illuminati. At capacity, scrap one to replace it.
Action-based resources enter with 0 actions, refill next own turn, and follow normal extra-refresh limits.
Resources do not count as groups or group Power and cannot provide normal support. Passive, triggered, and one-use resources follow their own text. Scrapped resources cannot be recovered this game.
Requisition to hand is not scrapping. Swapped resources retain state but lose their actions and cannot be readied that turn.

P (Power): Leads attacks, self-defends, and provides eligible support. GP (Global Power): Support when P is not eligible. Never add P and GP. R (Resistance): Base defense against Control.

Opposites: Government–Corporate, Liberal–Conservative, Peaceful–Violent, Straight–Weird, Fanatic–Fanatic. Criminal has no opposite. Fanatic never counts as a shared alignment.
Control: Compare leader with target. +4 per shared alignment; −4 per opposing pair. Destroy reverses these modifiers.

Loyalty: +4 per alignment shared with the direct parent; Control defense only. Opposing alignments do not subtract loyalty.
Position: +10 for direct subordinates of the Illuminati, +5 for the next level, +0 deeper. Applies to Control and Destroy.
Self-defense: Spend the target’s action for an extra 2 × P defense.

Support: Compare supporter with the attacked target. Control attack: shared alignment uses P. Destroy attack: opposing alignments use P. Defense: shared alignment or direct parent/child uses P. Otherwise use GP. Normally costs the supporter’s action.

Tags are separate: Military, Communist, Magic, Space, Celebrity, Place, etc. matter only when named by a rule or card. They give no automatic alignment modifier. Huge and Coastal are also tags.

Small cards abbreviate alignments; inspect a card to see the full names. Country marks national Places; states, cities, and ports do not count.
